page.layout: One column of verse, lines set in indented stanzas, running from the top of the page to the lower half. Page number at top left, running head at top right. Catchword at the lower right, below the last line.

p.i: Audax Guifiadum genus Deceptum magicis cantibus, & sibi Francum debita somnians Regna, & pollicitus excitum Ibericis[?] Terra miscuit athera.
Produxitque suis seditionibus Belli iurgia ciuici, Et Gallos varius cladibus obruit.

Audax Gens Lotharingica Dum se Pontificum religionibus Addictam magis omnibus Fingit, dum veteres, quas vocat, hæreses Ardet perdere funditus, O quam multiplices cauta reconditis Texit pectoribus dolos, Fraudes, insidias, prefidiam & scelus, Regi perniciem suo, Gallis feruitium turpius apparans.
Sed qui sceptra Deus tibi, Rex Henrice, dedit Gallica flectere, Hic mentis quoque prouidæ[?] Iunctum Consilium viribus addidit.
Sic nunc lethiferam caues Gentis perfidiam fortior impiæ. Sic regnum tibi traditum Iamiam propitio Numine vindicas.
Sic spes Guifiadum vagas, Optatámque tua morte Tyrannidem

page.notes: Printed in italic type throughout. Doubtful readings marked with [?]: "Ibericis" (final letter unclear), "quoque" (the letter before "que" is a ligature-like form). The rest is read from the scan. The faint mirrored text in the right margin is show-through and is left out.
